name: Lanka Environment Fund Grants
summary: Rolling grants from a Conservation Collective foundation for local non-profits and community groups to run fieldwork, restoration, community engagement and other conservation projects; decided at quarterly committee meetings.

steps: Optional: email a short concept note to LEF before applying
Steering Committee decision (four meetings a year)

eligibility.rule: Consults, mobilises and involves local communities in the project

calls.label: Rolling applications

status.quote: Applications for funding will be accepted on a rolling basis.

calls.note: Prior to applying for funding, please contact us to see if your project is viable for funding.

administered_by.quote: ©2024 Lanka Environment Fund | Registered Charity Number GA 00213160

applicant_types.quote: Local non-profit organisations working towards environmental conservation are highly recommended to apply for grants. Associations, clubs, social cooperatives and other local community based organisations are encouraged to apply for grants.

geography.quote: supports existing conservation initiatives in Sri Lanka with their work by providing grant funding

access.quote: All applicants need to complete and submit our application form.

window.quote: Applications for funding will be accepted on a rolling basis.

effort.quote: However, prior to applying, please contact us to see if your project is viable for funding.
All applicants need to complete and submit our application form.

OPTIONAL: Before you complete an application, we encourage you to contact us via email, sharing a short concept note (max 250 words) with the amount you need for the work to express your interest in funding.
Decisions will be made at Steering Committee meetings which are held 4 times per year.

eligibility.quote: The applicants must display strong effective leadership and emphasise on integrated bottom up approaches, by consulting with, mobilizing and involving local communities in a manner that demonstrates positive community impact.

after_award.quote: Please note that at the end of the project, you will be asked to report on these indicators.

documents.quote: Documents required to complete the application: Proof of Legal Status Budget Template (to be uploaded in Section 7 of this application form).
